sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior instruction: do not use a self-asserted iceOperationApplicable=false branch to make the substantive PWOM requirement vacuously pass. Replace it with a verified applicability basis or authoritative canonical evidence for non-applicability, and apply the complete set of declared ship-owned direct constraints only when that basis establishes applicability. A canonical authoritative applicability/evidence term is absent from the supplied scoped vocabulary, so locate it with the variable matcher; retain the supplied canonical terms, ship target, datatypes, and DIRECT_STATIC mode.
